correctness.rationale: All permitted cyclic four-gram vectors correspond exactly to nonzero nonnegative integer flows on the explicit six-vertex, ten-arc de Bruijn subgraph with connected positive support. The five-coordinate balance solution is bijectively split into two nonnegative parameter cones whose generating functions sum to (1+z^6)/D. Exhaustive simple-cycle classification shows disconnected flows are exactly unions of two disjoint three-cycles or one two-cycle and one four-cycle, yielding both subtractions. Euler tours prove converse realizability. Exact denominator factorization proves the coefficient degree and period; 12,596 constructed flows and exhaustive words through length 18 corroborate the proof.

value.rationale: Simultaneous length-two run limits on both symbols are motivated by constrained signaling and homopolymer avoidance. The theorem gives all-length exact zero-error cyclic four-read profile capacity, a constructive realizability criterion and a sharp degree-four period-twelve quasipolynomial. The two distinct disconnected circulation obstructions provide a substantive structural boundary beyond merely enumerating nonnegative solutions or repeating a known table.
